user_query: Can you recommend a medium-roast espresso blend with chocolate notes? Whole beans are fine, but I was hoping for a bag around 500 g.

product_entry.product_description: A balanced espresso blend with cocoa, toasted hazelnut, and brown sugar notes. Developed for espresso and moka pot, with enough sweetness to work well in milk-based drinks.

matching_rationale: The medium roast, espresso-oriented blend, whole-bean format, and cocoa notes fit the main preferences. The 340 g package is notably smaller than the requested size of around 500 g, so the match is relevant but not exact.
